2026-11-08 (Lane B, linear contract waits): three controls were added and declared before a frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of their exact bytes (declaration sha256 8b5021878cad80c27fca501cabdb0120f4637264feb572ed74b9db10af6fe374, retained as obj/lane-b3/declarations/lifetime-contract-waits.declared.json; oracle receipt obj/lane-b3/oracle-contract-waits/receipt.json). `earlier-nominal-length.rs` reduces a body whose first nominal completes before a later one waits; before the repair this compiler rejected it with "missing nominal outlives facts". The two chain shapes wait inside one nominal's closure. The original eight cases are unchanged

field-length.rs.reason: a struct field length calls a const fn whose argument relates `Note<'static>` to `Note<'_>`, which needs Note's covariance before the crate-wide variance pass

signature-length.rs.reason: the same length in a function signature

later-nominal-length.rs.reason: the length's callee relates a lifetime nominal declared after the length's owner

covariant-shrink-length.rs.reason: a reached const fn shortens a covariant `Note<'b>` to `Note<'a>` under `'b: 'a`

implied-outlives-length.rs.reason: a reached const fn returns `*pair.r: &'b u8` as `&'a u8`, which only `Pair<'a, &'b u8>`'s inferred `T: 'a` contract implies

covariant-widen-length.rs.reason: opponent: a reached const fn widens `Note<'a>` to `Note<'static>`; a lifetime does not live long enough

invariant-shrink-length.rs.reason: opponent: `Slot<'a>` holds `&'a mut &'a str`, so it is invariant and `Slot<'b>` is not `Slot<'a>` under only `'b: 'a`

outlives-escape-length.rs.reason: opponent: the implied `'b: 'a` does not give `'b: 'static`

earlier-nominal-length.rs.reason: the length's callee relates `Maybe`, whose field template is published, and `Late`, declared after the length's owner; the body demands both nominals' outlives contracts though only `Late` waits

covariant-chain-length.rs.reason: a reached const fn shortens `Link0<'b>` to `Link0<'a>` under `'b: 'a`; `Link0` reaches `Link2` through two referenced nominals declared after the length's owner, all covariant

invariant-chain-length.rs.reason: opponent: the same chain ends in `&'a mut &'a str`, so `Link0` is invariant through both references and `Link0<'b>` is not `Link0<'a>` under only `'b: 'a`
